provenance.description: Read-only export of real TomTom V2 POIs already cached by HomeSpace; no new provider calls were made.
provenance.note: Names, coordinates, external IDs, category assignments and source timestamps are preserved from the existing cache. This is not a fresh TomTom response for each seeded listing. New listing-to-place links must be recomputed from real stored coordinates and restricted to the 2 km radius; no coordinates or missing POI categories are invented. An empty local selection means the exported snapshot has no known matches, not that the area has no real amenities.
